text:
aisha: alerting — NY C2: control-plane auth API is returning 504s, worker heartbeats dropping fast, large eviction spike. seeing 50% of gpu nodes NotReady in last 2m. any oncall?

sre-bot: [automated] region-availability:nyc2 severity=high triggered by heartbeat-missing > 30s for 42 nodes, control-plane-504s > 5m

oncall: I'm on it. aisha can you paste the last 2m of node statuses and any recent kube events?

aisha: kubectl get nodes | grep -E "NotReady|Ready" -- here's a tiny snippet:

```
gpu-node-134 NotReady  12m  kubelet: NodeHasSufficientMemory
gpu-node-145 NotReady  3m   kubelet: NetworkPluginNotReady
gpu-node-202 Ready     10m
```

also from controlplane logs:
```
[2026-03-20T02:12:03Z] auth: 504 downstream timeout
[2026-03-20T02:12:10Z] scheduler: DB conn error, retrying
```

miguel: huh — sounds like controlplane db or network plane. can we check controlplane-to-etcd and s3 access? 

jon: grabbing metrics. grafana:nyc2 -> controlplane_rpc_latency spiked x10 at 02:10 and node kubelet heartbeat drop aligns. suspect top-of-rack switch flapping or controller replicas partitioned.

tara: if this is a network fabric issue, we should prepare traffic-shift to sfo1 asap. are we in the middle of any rolling deploys? aisha any provisioning jobs in flight?

aisha: there was a small batch provisioning job for reserved capacity 3h ago, nothing in last 15m. no manual deploys.

oncall: immediate action items:
- collect `kubectl get events --all-namespaces --since=5m` (aisha)
- check controlplane pod logs for leader election / etcd timeouts (miguel)
- verify whether BGP session resets for nyc2 edge (jon)
- enable traffic fence: route 10% -> sfo1, 50% -> fallback pool (tara)

miguel: running logs: etcd follower reports "raft: heartbeat timeout" and flapping TLS handshakes to other replicas.

jon: network checks: edge-router X shows repeated BGP RESETs to peer 203.0.113.12, interface e-agg3 flaps. possible vendor-side issue. opening ticket with provider.

aisha: events dump:
```
Warning  NodeNotReady  2m kubelet, gpu-node-145 NetworkPluginNotReady: cni failed
Warning  Eviction      1m kubelet, pod/onnx-worker Warning: eviction threshold crossed
```

tara: ok, priority: protect customer traffic. plan:
1) enable canary traffic-shift: 20% -> sfo1, 30% -> eu-central1, keep 50% local for now with strict circuit breaker
2) disable autoscaler and provisioning in nyc2 to stop churn
3) spin up temporary replacement control-plane replica in sfo1 and promote if leader lost

oncall: doing step 1 now. using routing playbook: `./playbooks/traffic-shift --from=nyc2 --to=sfo1,eu-central1 --weights=20,30 --dry-run=false`

sre-bot: [automated] runbook-step: traffic-shift started by oncall at 02:22Z

miguel: I'm snapshotting etcd and will try to stand up a proxy replica in sfo1. copying logs to /var/tmp/nyc2-incident

jon: provider ticket created: #PROV-91321 — reporting flapping at agg3, they acknowledge and are investigating.

aisha: quick customer impact check — API errors have increased by 12% for hosted customers in nyc2, embeddings latency +3x for some customers. posting to status page draft.

tara: cost note — if we promote sfo1 control-plane and keep fallback capacity, this will burn through reserved burst credits. we should flag billing and PMs but prioritize availability.

oncall: status update: traffic-shift in progress, provider engaged, team triaging control-plane. will escalate to oncall-sre-lead if no leader recovery in 15m. tagging #incident-response for visibility. :rotating_light:

miguel: workaround attempt: `kubectl -n redwood-system exec cp-pod-0 -- /bin/sh -c "etcdctl endpoint health"` shows endpoint unhealthy, trying proxy to other endpoints.

jon: provider reports partial fiber maintenance in region at ~02:09Z correlating with our spike. they offered live update channel.

aisha: posting initial incident summary to channel and creating incident ticket INC-20260320-nyc2 with current symptoms and actions.

sre-bot: [automated] note: if control-plane leader fails, auto-failover limits require manual promotion to avoid split-brain. follow runbook section 4.

tara: good call. everyone focus on stabilization, small clear steps. I'll coordinate customer comms and billing heads.

oncall: next check-in 02:40Z or earlier if status changes. keep threads concise.

miguel: standing up proxy replica attempt failed due to TLS handshake timeout; will try using historical snapshot and read-only proxy to unblock metrics.

aisha: thanks team. updating incident ticket now.
